_comment: delegation/ORCHESTRATION.json — normally the run config for an orchestrate.mjs-driven autonomous build (D32). Kept here in a self-parallel round PURELY to record the tier policy the manually-relayed MiniMax M3 worker is expected to follow, since delegation/README.md deliberately reuses WORKER-SESSION.md's tight-brief shape. workerCmd is intentionally blank and scripts/orchestrate.mjs is NOT used for dispatch in this project — the user is the relay. See delegation/README.md 'The setup' for the full reasoning.
_harness: Not applicable in the orchestrate.mjs sense here (no scripted dispatch). Left as 'generic' for schema consistency only.
_workerCmd: Intentionally blank. MiniMax Coder is a Windows GUI desktop app with no CLI hook to shell out to — dispatch is manual (the user copies delegation/tasks/<id>/WORKER-PROMPT.md into MiniMax Coder and copies the result back). Do not fill this in unless MiniMax Coder ever exposes a scriptable CLI/headless mode, at which point this round should probably be re-recorded as auditor-remote instead of self-parallel.
_maxParallel: One worker (MiniMax M3), one task at a time, manually relayed. No concurrency.
_maxRetries: If a returned task fails audit, it goes back to MiniMax once with specific, concrete fixes named by the auditor — never patched by Claude directly (same 'a session that wrote the code is the wrong session to judge it' principle the kit applies to its own auditor/worker split). A second failure escalates to the user rather than a second silent retry.
_tierPolicy: Same as the kit default: MiniMax may decide T0 (mechanical, reversible, already settled by spec) and T1 (judgement inside locked scope — but must write the reasoning in its returned notes) alone. T2 (irreversible, externally visible, spec-contradicting, or below its own confidence) always stops and comes back to the user via the relay. Uncertainty resolves to T2, never T1 — see tins-kit/lib/patterns/tiered-escalation.md.
_haltOn: Not applicable to a single-task-per-round manual relay — kept empty for schema consistency with the kit template.
